agent.cancel.description: Cancel or halt the active turn (optionally checking `turn_id` and/or clearing queued inputs) and return any removed queued items.

reason.description: Cancellation cause (`user`, `parent`, `hook`, `disposed`) or free-form note (classified as `user`).

content.description: Optional ordered content blocks with image bytes stripped (preserved on cancel).

data.description: Base64 payload (included when returned by `agent.cancel` for draft recovery).

mime.description: MIME type of the queued image attachment.

path.description: Optional workspace path of the image.

size.description: Optional byte length of the image.

input_context.description: Opaque caller-supplied JSON metadata preserved with the queued input.

agent.continue.description: Resume an interrupted turn or run queued inputs (`steer` and `follow_up`).

agent.delete_queued.description: Remove one queued input item by `input_id`.

agent.get.description: Snapshot of current agent activity (`busy`, `turn_id`, `queued` count, `model`, `effort`, `activity`).

extra_errors.description: Errors from failed activity snapshot providers.

agent.list_messages.description: Current conversation messages visible to the model (optionally paginated by cursor and limit).

agent.list_queue.description: Queued inputs in delivery order (steer items first, then follow-ups; image metadata only).

content.description: Optional ordered content blocks with image bytes stripped (preserved on cancel).

data.description: Base64 payload (included when returned by `agent.cancel` for draft recovery).

mime.description: MIME type of the queued image attachment.

path.description: Optional workspace path of the image.

size.description: Optional byte length of the image.

input_context.description: Opaque caller-supplied JSON metadata preserved with the queued input.

agent.prompt.description: Submit user input to the agent (queued inputs enter follow_up by default, or steer via `agent.steer`); starts a turn when idle, or handles busy state via `when_busy` (`queue` default, or `reject`).

mime.description: MIME type for media or file parts.

path.description: Workspace path for `file` or local `image` parts.

agent.steer.description: Inject steering input into the currently running turn.

mime.description: MIME type for media or file parts.

path.description: Workspace path for `file` or local `image` parts.

agent.update_queued.description: Update the content and/or lane of one queued input item.

mime.description: MIME type for media or file parts.

path.description: Workspace path for `file` or local `image` parts.

content.description: Optional ordered content blocks with image bytes stripped (preserved on cancel).

data.description: Base64 payload (included when returned by `agent.cancel` for draft recovery).

mime.description: MIME type of the queued image attachment.

path.description: Optional workspace path of the image.

size.description: Optional byte length of the image.

input_context.description: Opaque caller-supplied JSON metadata preserved with the queued input.

agent.wait.description: Block until the specified (or active) turn settles and return its `Turn` snapshot.

completed_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the turn finished.

messages.description: Session messages visible at turn end.

not_sent.description: True when the prompt failed before reaching the provider.

save_warning.description: Quarantine/save failure warning when another error took precedence.

started_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the turn started.

status.description: Turn completion outcome (or `running` when `wait` timed out).

structured.description: Validated structured output when `output_schema` was supplied.

text.description: Final assistant text produced during the turn.

timed_out.description: True when `agent.wait` returned on `timeout_ms` before settlement.

usage.description: Aggregated token/cost usage for the turn.

cells.cancel.description: Cancel an active cell owned by this caller.

cells.get.description: Status of the caller's cell environment.

cells.list.description: List cells owned by this caller.

cells.list_tools.description: Discover tools currently callable from code cells, including the MCP codemode tier.

cells.reset.description: Cancel active cells owned by this caller and release caller-owned retained VM state.

cells.start.description: Start an asynchronous script cell in this caller's scope and wait up to yield_time_ms for initial output or completion. Lua callers may pass `cancel` / `wait_cancel` returning their cancel token.

cells.wait.description: Wait for an active or completed cell owned by this caller, consuming newly emitted output. terminate cancels the cell and waits up to 5 s. Lua callers may pass `cancel` returning their cancel token.

commands.get.description: Current definition data of command `name` (or alias), or nil if absent.

commands.list.description: Registered non-alias slash commands, sorted by name (data only, no callbacks).

commands.register.description: Register a slash command or alias (`alias_of`) owned by the caller; remote callers must pass `replace = true` to overwrite an existing name, and releasing a registration restores any previous definition.

commands.run.description: Run a slash command line (optionally targeting a loaded `session_id`); returns {result?} on success and throws a coded error on failure.

compact.run.description: Compact the session's context now (`reason`: manual by default); `instructions` adds a focus to the summary. Returns `{status, tokens_before, tokens_after}` (or `{status = "summarized", tokens_before = 0, tokens_after = 0, summary, dropped}` with `summarize_only`). A failure raises `compact.not_compacted`.

fs.list.description: List directory entries filtered by the active sandbox read policy.

fs.read.description: Read a file as base64, bounded by active sandbox policy and optional max_bytes.

fs.stat.description: Inspect file metadata within the active sandbox read policy.

fs.watch.description: Watch a workspace path for policy-filtered filesystem changes (emits `fs/changed`; release via `registrations.release`).

fs.write.description: Write base64 bytes to a file within writable sandbox roots and protected-path exclusions.

hooks.subscribe.description: Subscribe `handle(event, mode, args)` to a bus event or policy decision point. Returns a registration removed on release or client disconnect. `prepend = true` inserts before earlier listeners (`prepend = false` keeps append order); `timeout_ms` requires `>= 1` and is clamped to the host policy timeout ceiling for remote callers.

jobs.background.description: Mark a job as backgrounded so completion emits a notification.

jobs.cancel.description: Request a running job to stop (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after kill_grace_ms).

jobs.list.description: Background jobs in start order, optionally filtered by owner (with optional cursor pagination).

jobs.read.description: Non-consumingly read job output starting at byte `offset`, with a trailing [status: ...] line.

llm.get_model.description: The session's current model, or with ref any model the providers resolve (hidden ones and ids a provider serves without listing them included); never changes the selection.

ref.description: describe this model instead (hidden or unlisted ones too); the selection is unchanged

llm.list_auth_keys.description: Stored credential key names in `auth.json`, optionally filtered by literal prefix; never returns secret values.

llm.list_models.description: Every visible model with its abilities, sorted by ref.

llm.list_providers.description: Providers and their masked login state; never a secret value.

llm.login.description: Run a provider's login. Without key the flow is interactive and needs a connected UI; Lua callers may pass their own say/ask/choose functions.

llm.logout.description: Remove every stored credential of a provider (revoked first where possible); kept lists the environment and config sources that cannot be removed here.

llm.register_provider.description: Register an LLM provider (`provider`, `default_model?`, `models?`, `replace?`) and optional remote `stream` callback; released on disposer/release or disconnect.

llm.set_effort.description: Set the reasoning effort of the current model. target session|global (default global) decides whether it is remembered; scope_name names an override scope; also_global updates the unscoped value as well.

llm.set_model.description: Select a model after admitting its context budget; target session keeps the default, global (the default) also saves it. A compaction error keeps the old selection.

mcp.connect.description: Connect one configured MCP server and return its status.

mcp.get_prompt.description: Expand a prompt on a configured MCP server.

mcp.list_prompts.description: Prompts exposed by connected MCP servers (or one named server).

mcp.list_resources.description: Resources and resource templates exposed by connected MCP servers (or one named server).

mcp.list_servers.description: Configured MCP servers and their current connection status (never connects).

mcp.list_tools.description: Tools discovered from configured MCP servers (or one named server).

mcp.read_resource.description: Read one MCP resource URI from a server.

mcp.reconnect.description: Reconnect one configured MCP server and return its status.

message.append.description: Append a custom message that enters model context while honoring display, delivery, and optional `request_id` idempotency.

message.list_types.description: List currently registered custom message types in sorted name order.

message.register_type.description: Register a custom message type with optional validation and render callbacks; returns a disposer (`registration_id` over RPC).

permissions.get.description: Current active permission preset and policy revision for this session (`rules` and `grants` are included for primary/in-process callers and omitted for peer callers).

permissions.list.description: Available permission presets (built-in and configured) with display metadata and active indicator.

permissions.set.description: Switch the active permission preset (`confirm` asks before the first switch to full access); returns the updated permission state or raises a coded error.

plugins.check.description: Fetch and compare plugin revisions without moving checkouts or modifying locks.

plugins.install.description: Install a catalog plugin by short name or sync a declared source; raises `plugins.failed` on error.

name.description: Optional plugin short name or declared source name; omitted operates on all eligible sources.

reload.description: When true and the package operation succeeds, run a full host reload.

plugins.list.description: Declared/installed packages, parsed `mare-plugin.toml` manifests, and resource directories.

kind.description: Optional content kind (`skills | prompts | themes | types`) for `dirs`; omitted returns package roots.

plugins.uninstall.description: Uninstall a catalog plugin by short name or clean an unused source; raises `plugins.failed` on error.

name.description: Optional plugin short name or declared source name; omitted operates on all eligible sources.

reload.description: When true and the package operation succeeds, run a full host reload.

plugins.update.description: Update declared git packages to their newest allowed revision (`update`); raises `plugins.failed` on error.

name.description: Optional plugin short name or declared source name; omitted operates on all eligible sources.

reload.description: When true and the package operation succeeds, run a full host reload.

stash.description: Save local changes and untracked files in git stash before updating.

query.call.description: Run an in-process query operation inside an ephemeral-read-only sandbox rooted at the active execution context's cwd, or at `mare.cwd` when called directly from Lua without an active `mare.exec.current()`. Lua callers may pass `cancel`, a function returning their cancel token or nil.

query.list_providers.description: Registered query providers and the operations they serve, sorted by name.

session.add_record.description: Append a custom plugin record outside the model message tree.

session.archive.description: Archive a saved inactive session (and its child agent sessions) by id, unique prefix, or path.

session.close.description: Unload the active session runtime and release its lock without exiting the host.

session.create.description: Create a new idle session runtime (optionally named, in cwd, or idempotent by request_id).

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

loaded.description: Whether this session is loaded in the current host.

name.description: Optional user-assigned or generated session name.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

path.description: On-disk JSONL file path when saved.

session.delete.description: Permanently delete a saved inactive session (and its child agent sessions) by id, unique prefix, or path.

session.fork.description: Create a new session forked from an active or saved session (optionally before an item).

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

loaded.description: Whether this session is loaded in the current host.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

source_leaf_entry_id.description: Source leaf entry id observed when creating a snapshot, if any.

session.get_item.description: Read one semantic item by session_id and item_id, inline or UTF-8 chunked, with optional neighbors.

session.label_item.description: Set or clear a label on a session entry (defaults to the current leaf).

session.list.description: List saved sessions in the index, newest first.

path.description: On-disk JSONL file path when saved.

source_leaf_entry_id.description: Source leaf entry id observed when creating a snapshot, if any.

session.list_items.description: List semantic items of the open session, optionally filtered by branch, item type, or order.

session.list_records.description: List custom plugin records of the given kind in the open session.

session.load.description: Load an existing session by session_id, unique prefix, name, or (for primary) path.

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

session.rewind.description: Move the active session leaf back before an item (optionally summarizing or restoring files).

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

loaded.description: Whether this session is loaded in the current host.

name.description: Optional user-assigned or generated session name.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

path.description: On-disk JSONL file path when saved.

session.search.description: Full-text and metadata search across persisted and live sessions in the active workspace.

session.search_items.description: Search matching semantic items inside one session under workspace policy.

session.snapshot.description: Create a persisted fork snapshot of an active or saved session without changing the active session target or cancelling running turns.

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

loaded.description: Whether this session is loaded in the current host.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

path.description: On-disk JSONL file path when saved.

source_leaf_entry_id.description: Source leaf entry id observed when creating a snapshot, if any.

session.trace.description: Trace ancestor and descendant session lineage under workspace policy.

session.trace_item.description: Trace the containing entry and compaction surface for one semantic item.

session.unarchive.description: Restore an archived session (and its child agent sessions) by id, unique prefix, or path.

session.update.description: Rename the open session (optionally guarded by expected_revision) and return its Session snapshot.

archived.description: Whether the session is archived in the index.

ephemeral.description: Whether the session is running with persistence disabled.

leaf_entry_id.description: Current leaf entry id when loaded.

name_revision.description: Monotonic revision of the session name when loaded.

parent_session_id.description: Parent or fork-origin session id, if any.

spill.delete.description: Invalidate and delete a session-owned spill object.

spill.list_backends.description: Registered spill storage backends, with which one is currently selected.

spill.read.description: Read a UTF-8 text page (default) or base64 byte page (`encoding = "base64"`) from a session-owned spill object.

spill.save.description: Persist UTF-8 text (`content`) or strict padded base64 bytes (`data_base64`, max 8 MiB decoded) in the active session's spill storage.

subagent.cancel.description: Request cancellation of a subagent and its descendants.

subagent.get.description: Get a subagent by its subagent_id (or unique name).

subagent_id.description: Unique identifier (child session id) of the subagent.

subagent.list.description: List subagents started in this host (optionally paginated by cursor and limit).

subagent_id.description: Unique identifier (child session id) of the subagent.

subagent.list_types.description: List current subagent type definitions in bytewise name order.

subagent.register_type.description: Register a session-owned subagent type. Names use ASCII letters, digits, underscore, hyphen or dot; tool lists are dense, nonempty-string arrays without duplicates.

subagent.start.description: Start an isolated child subagent and return its subagent info.

subagent_id.description: Unique identifier (child session id) of the subagent.

subagent.steer.description: Deliver steering input to a running subagent.

subagent.wait.description: Wait for a subagent to finish (non-consuming; timeout or cancellation does not cancel the child).

subagent_id.description: Unique identifier (child session id) of the subagent.

terminal.close.description: Stop and close an owned PTY session cleanly.

grace_ms.description: Optional SIGTERM grace period in milliseconds (0..30000, default 3000).

terminal.create.description: Create an owner-bound PTY session; automatically closed when the caller context or RPC connection ends.

name.description: Optional unique name within this owner (1..128 bytes).

terminal.list.description: List PTY sessions owned by the caller connection or plugin.

terminal.read.description: Read incremental `output_offset` or VT-paged output from an owned PTY, capped at `max_bytes` bytes.

max_bytes.description: Maximum output bytes to return (1..4194304, default 262144). Applies to both incremental `output_offset` slicing (UTF-8 safe, floor one char) and VT page mode as well as `screen`; sets `truncated` true when capped.

terminal.send.description: Send input bytes/text to an owned PTY and optionally wait for output/exit, capped at `max_bytes` bytes.

max_bytes.description: Maximum output bytes to return (1..4194304, default 262144). Output is truncated at a UTF-8 boundary (always returning at least one character if non-empty) and sets `truncated` true; when `screen` is true, rendered screen is head-trimmed to fit and sets `view_truncated`.

terminal.signal.description: Deliver a signal to the foreground process group of an owned PTY.

theme.list.description: Installed and registered themes, sorted by name.

theme.preview.description: Preview a theme. Affects rendering only, never the preference; ends with its caller.

theme.register.description: Register a theme owned by the caller. Duplicate or invalid definitions fail without changing state; releasing the registration removes only it, and releasing the selected theme restores auto.

theme.register_override.description: An owned style layer; later layers win, config.theme and explicit ui.style win over layers. Replacing a layer id keeps one layer; an older registration cannot remove its replacement.

theme.select.description: Validate, optionally save atomically, then publish the selection. save defaults to false (process only); init.lua still wins on the next start.

tools.register.description: Register a tool owned by the caller; released on disposer/release or disconnect. Remote registrations force `unconfined = true` and dispatch `execute(args, ctx)` via `callback.call`.

ui.call_keymap.description: Dispatch a key sequence or named keymap action in the session runtime.

ui.cancel_markdown.description: Cancel outstanding presenter work for a Markdown document and fall back to source.

ui.delete_keymap.description: Delete the topmost runtime keymap binding of a key sequence in a context.

ui.delete_markdown.description: Remove a caller-owned Markdown document and cancel its pending work.

ui.get_keymap.description: Return the runtime keymap snapshot (contexts, actions, bindings, and essential conflicts).

context.description: Optional context name to filter by.

ui.get_markdown.description: Latest rendered snapshot for a caller-owned Markdown document.

ui.get_select_preview.description: Evaluate the active `ui.select` preview callback for the highlighted item and tab.

ui.invalidate.description: Invalidate a rendered widget or status segment, or update viewport dimensions and trigger resize.

component.description: Widget (`widget:<id>` or widget id) or status segment id to redraw.

ui.invalidate_presentations.description: Invalidate cached Markdown presentations across active documents after a display or presenter state change.

ui.list_markdown_presenters.description: Active fenced-code presenter registrations, sorted by language.

ui.register_entry_renderer.description: Register a display-only custom entry renderer owned by the caller.

ui.register_markdown_transform.description: Register a Markdown transformer for selected message surfaces, owned by the caller.

ui.render_markdown.description: Render fenced blocks in a caller-scoped Markdown document asynchronously via registered presenters.

ui.send_editor.description: Submit the current editor buffer (or override text) to the session's agent lane.

ui.set_external_editor.description: Acquire, commit, or cancel the per-session external editor lock.

ui.set_keymap.description: Bind or mask a key sequence in a context for the caller's lifetime.

ui.transform_markdown.description: Run registered Markdown transformers for a message surface.

ui.update_editor.description: Synchronize the external editor draft state and broadcast updated state to attached frontends.

usage.get.description: Totals, context tokens and rate limits of the session in one object.

web.fetch.description: Fetch a URL using the currently selected fetch backend under active sandbox limits.

web.list_providers.description: Registered web backends of `kind` sorted by provider_id, each marked `selected` when active.

web.register_fetch.description: Register a fetch backend owned by the caller; removed on release or disconnect.

web.register_search.description: Register a search backend owned by the caller; removed on release or disconnect.

web.search.description: Search the web using the currently selected search backend under active sandbox limits.

webserver.get.description: Status and bound endpoints of the host webserver listener.

webserver.list_assets.description: Registered static asset mounts on the host webserver.

webserver.list_routes.description: Registered HTTP routes on the host webserver.

webserver.register_assets.description: Register a static asset directory served under a URL prefix on the host webserver.

webserver.register_route.description: Register a named HTTP route on the host webserver. Requests are forwarded to the caller handler.

workspace.get.description: Return the canonical workspace root, trust state, and workspace directory list.

workspace.set_trust.description: Update project trust for this workspace across all active sessions attached to it.
